name: Unknown match slug shows a 404 view and recovers via home link
description: When a visitor navigates to a match slug that does not exist, the app renders a 404 indicator, and clicking the home or bracket link from that page returns the visitor to the homepage with the knockout bracket present.

planSteps.description: Verify the page surfaces a 404 indicator such as the text 404 or the phrase not found
Click the home, brand, or bracket link on the 404 page
Verify the destination page surfaces the knockout bracket section
